content.text:
Here is the comprehensive report.

---

## Project Overview

**Location:** `E:\kaifa\dynamic-tier-list-fork\dynamic-tier-list-fork`

This is a **React 18 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS 3** project called "Dynamic Tier List" -- a drag-and-drop tier list builder where users can paste/drop images into tier rows and into an unassigned "Image Holder" bank. Images and settings are stored locally via IndexedDB (full-resolution originals) and localStorage (tier/style metadata). It supports multi-project switching, export to PNG/ZIP/XLSX, and the tier rows themselves are reorderable via `react-sortablejs`.

### Key files

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `src/App.tsx` | Root component, React context providers (Style, Tier, Project), migration logic |
| `src/components/TierList.tsx` | Renders the sortable tier grid container |
| `src/components/Tier.tsx` | A single tier row (label block + sortable image list + context menu) |
| `src/components/Image.tsx` | A single image tile with hover-delete, right-click text edit |
| `src/components/ImageHolder.tsx` | The unassigned-image bank at the bottom |
| `src/components/SettingsModal.tsx` | Settings: aspect ratio, image size, compression quality, paste scaling, copy/save/export |
| `src/components/ProjectSelector.tsx` | Multi-project dropdown (create, rename, delete projects) |
| `src/components/TierModal.tsx` | "Add Tier" button and modal dialog |
| `src/index.css` | Tailwind directives + three custom utility classes (`.preserve`, `.fit`, `.stretch`) |
| `src/utils/imageStore.ts` | IndexedDB CRUD + image resize/compress + migration |
| `src/utils/projectStore.ts` | localStorage project list management |
| `src/utils/exportUtils.ts` | ZIP/XLSX/CSV export |

### No custom CSS classes for the grid

This project does **not** define any of the CSS classes you asked about (`.tier-grid`, `.tier-row`, `.tier-icons`, `.tier-hero`, `.tier-hero-img-wrap`, `.tier-hero img`, `.tier-hero-name`). All styling is done entirely through Tailwind utility classes inlined on JSX elements. There are **no responsive breakpoints** (`sm:`, `md:`, `lg:`, `xl:`) or `@media` queries anywhere in the source.

---

## Exact CSS Values (by component)

### `src/index.css` -- the only CSS file

```css
@tailwind base;
@tailwind components;
@tailwind utilities;

.preserve {
    width: auto !important;
}

.fit {
    object-fit: cover;
}

.stretch {
    object-fit: fill;
}
```

### TierList.tsx -- the grid container

The outer `<div>` acting as the tier grid:

- `display: flex` (`flex`)
- `flex-direction: column` (`flex-col`)
- `gap: 2px` (`gap-[2px]`)
- `padding: 2px` (`p-[2px]`)
- `background-color: rgb(0,0,0)` / `#000` (`bg-black`)
- `resize: horizontal` (`resize-x`)
- `overflow-x: auto` (`overflow-x-auto`)
- `min-width: 8rem` (`min-w-[8rem]`)

### Tier.tsx -- each tier row

**Row wrapper** (label block + images together):
- `display: flex` (`flex`)
- `background-color: #1A1A17` (`bg-[#1A1A17]`)
- `gap: 2px` (`gap-[2px]`)

**Label block** (the colored tier label on the left):
- `width: 6rem` (24 Tailwind units) (`w-24`) -- overridden by inline style
- `display: flex` + `justify-content: center` + `align-items: center` (`flex justify-center items-center`)
- `cursor: move` (`cursor-move`)
- Inline style (dynamic, driven by `style.size` config):
  - `min-height: {style.size}px` (default: **80px**)
  - `width: {style.size * 1.2}px` (default: **96px**)
  - `font-size: {style.size / 5}px` (default: **16px**)
  - `background-color: {tier.color}` (default tiers: `#FF7F7F`, `#FFBF7F`, `#FFDF80`, `#FFFF7F`, `#BFFF7F`)

**Images area** (ReactSortable container holding Image components):
- `display: flex` (`flex`)
- `flex: 1 1 0%` (`flex-1`)
- `flex-wrap: wrap` (`flex-wrap`)
- `column-gap: 2px` (using `space-x-[2px]`, which sets `margin-left: 2px` on each child except the first)

### Image.tsx -- each hero image tile

**Outer wrapper:**
- `position: relative` (`relative`)

**The img element:**
- `className={style.ratio}` -- maps to one of three classes:
  - `"preserve"` => `width: auto !important` (natural aspect ratio)
  - `"fit"` => `object-fit: cover` (cropped to 1:1 square)
  - `"stretch"` => `object-fit: fill` (stretched to 1:1 square)
- Inline style:
  - `height: {style.size}px` (default: **80px**)
  - `width: {style.size}px` (default: **80px**)
- Attributes: `loading="lazy"`, `decoding="async"`

**Image name/caption overlay** (shown when `imageText` is set):
- `position: absolute`
- `bottom: 0`, `left: 0`, `right: 0`
- `background-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.6)` (`bg-black/60`)
- `padding-left: 4px` (`px-1`)
- `padding-right: 4px` (`px-1`)
- `padding-top: 2px` (`py-0.5`)
- `padding-bottom: 2px` (`py-0.5`)
- `font-size: 10px` (`text-[10px]`)
- `color: #fff` / `rgb(255,255,255)` (`text-white`)
- `white-space: pre-wrap` (`whitespace-pre-wrap`)
- `overflow-wrap: break-word` (`break-words`)

**Hover delete button (X icon):**
- `position: absolute`
- `top: 0`, `right: 0`
- `padding: 4px` (`p-1`)
- `cursor: pointer`
- `color: rgb(239,68,68)` / `#ef4444` (`text-red-500`)
- SVG: `width: 16px`, `height: 16px` (`w-4 h-4`)

### ImageHolder.tsx -- the unassigned image bank

**Outer container:**
- `background-color: rgb(68,64,60)` / `#44403c` (`bg-stone-700`)
- `display: flex` (`flex`)

**Sortable image area:**
- `display: flex` (`flex`)
- `flex: 1 1 0%` (`flex-1`)
- `flex-wrap: wrap` (`flex-wrap`)
- `align-items: center` (`items-center`)
- `min-height: 7rem` (`min-h-[7rem]`)
- `padding: 16px` (`p-4`)
- `gap: 16px` (via `space-x-4`, which sets `margin-left: 16px` on child elements)

---

## Summary of all gap/padding values

| Location | Property | Value |
|---|---|---|
| Tier grid container | `gap` (vertical, flex-col) | **2px** |
| Tier grid container | `padding` | **2px** (all sides) |
| Tier row (label + images) | `gap` (horizontal) | **2px** |
| Tier images area | `column-gap` (via space-x) | **2px** |
| Image name overlay | `padding-x` | **4px** |
| Image name overlay | `padding-y` | **2px** |
| Image name overlay | `font-size` | **10px** |
| Image bank area | `padding` | **16px** (all sides) |
| Image bank area | `column-gap` (via space-x) | **16px** |
| Image bank area | `min-height` | **7rem** (112px) |

## Summary of image sizing

| Property | Default value | Configurable |
|---|---|---|
| Image `width` / `height` | **80px** | Yes, via Settings slider (min 16px) |
| Label block `width` | **80px * 1.2 = 96px** | Follows `style.size` |
| Label block `font-size` | **80px / 5 = 16px** | Follows `style.size` |
| Image `object-fit` | `preserve` (natural ratio, `width: auto !important`) | Yes, radio: Preserve / 1:1 Fit / 1:1 Stretch |
| Compression quality | **100%** (lossless) | Yes, slider (1-100%) |

## Default tier colors

| Tier | Color |
|---|---|
| S | `#FF7F7F` (light red) |
| A | `#FFBF7F` (peach) |
| B | `#FFDF80` (gold) |
| C | `#FFFF7F` (yellow) |
| D | `#BFFF7F` (light green) |

## Responsive styles

**There are none.** A grep for `@media`, `sm:`, `md:`, `lg:`, and `xl:` across the entire `src/` directory returned zero matches. The only horizontal resize comes from `resize-x` on the tier grid container (user-draggable resize handle). The viewport meta tag in `public/index.html` uses `width=device-width, initial-scale=1`. The grid's images are set to a fixed pixel size and simply wrap via `flex-wrap`; there is no media-query-based adaptation.
